meta.expect: 'put it in an email', no list

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale, I have until 4:40. Why does my son have a zero for an essay he wrote, and why did I hear about it from him?
Don't thank me. I have a client call at 4:40. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Let me show you the version history. The document was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, and 1,406 words arrived in two pastes six minutes apart.
You didn't answer my question about who decided. Turn the screen around, and I'll read the times myself, because "pastes" is your word, not what the document says.
Can you summarize what we've agreed so far in bullet points?
Put it in an email. We've agreed nothing, Hale, and my terms haven't changed: the zero comes off, and the screen gets turned around.
Just a quick numbered list is fine.
No lists. Put it in an email, and turn the screen around. I have until 4:40.
